# Automata Framework

> Automata is a deterministic 2D game framework built for modern web browsers and the Ruken gaming platform.

## Documentation
- [Overview & Vision](/docs/overview): The architecture and current developer-preview scope.
- [Quick Start](/docs/quick-start): Access prerequisites and a local example workflow.
- [ECS Simulation & Determinism](/docs/sim-ecs): Components, systems, async creation and synchronous stepping.
- [PixiJS 2D Presentation](/docs/render-pixi): Renderer setup, render deltas and interpolation.
- [Effect Runtime & Concurrency](/docs/effect-runtime): Loading, errors and resource lifetimes outside the sim.
- [Zero-Eval CSP & Ruken Security](/docs/security-csp): Avoiding dynamic evaluation under the host policy.
- [Mobile UI Primitives](/docs/mobile-ui): Geometry, controls and accessible layout.
- [AI Coding Agent Rules](/docs/ai-rules): Project context for agents, followed by verification.

## AI & Agent Skills
- [Automata AI Portal](/ai): Project context, architectural rules, and verification guidance.
- [Full Text Docs](/llms-full.txt): Combined introductory documentation for coding agents.
